Model B ''Pi''s use a [[SMSC]] LAN9512 (LAN9512-JZX) USB 2.0 hub and FE controller. :Earlier production run Raspberry Pi Model B (pre mid-October?) have :only 256MB of RAM. All subsequent Model Bs have 512MB of RAM.
